title: The dashboard shows no "Last updated" line
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as {User-A} (for example Admin ShopView), whose role has the Reports permission, at location {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919).
  • Your browser window is at least 1024 pixels wide at 100% zoom (a maximised laptop or desktop window).
custom_steps:
1. Click Dashboard in the top bar and wait for all six tiles to load.
  2. Read the whole page, from the top bar to below the last tile.
  3. Click View details on Revenue and read the panel that opens, down to its bottom edge.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Steps 2 and 3: Nowhere is there a "Last updated" line, a time such as "3 minutes ago", or any other note about when the figures were refreshed.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490; story SV-9575 (Story 3, Measure Formulas and Report Parity); Dashboard v1 PRD, Confluence 788430850, version 48 (14 Oct 2026, 17:09 UTC, Chris Ward), S3-N2 (added in version 45 on 14 Oct 2026 (15:06 UTC) by Chris Ward, from Chris Ward's answer 11 of 14 Oct 2026 to our question sheet; the spec's change log (version 46) lists it under 2026-10-14); read 14 Oct 2026. The design canvas shows a "Last updated" line; PRD version 45 (14 Oct 2026) says there is none, and we take the later PRD as prevailing. Page change: https://shopview.atlassian.net/wiki/pages/diffpagesbyversion.action?pageId=788430850&selectedPageVersions=44&selectedPageVersions=45. Source-verified 14 October 2026. Not yet checked against a build.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S3-N2: “The dashboard shows no "Last updated" line or any other freshness indicator. Its figures are never behind the reports (S3-R1), so there is nothing to be out of date.”
